Then it creates a map of known certificates, calls `keyStore.size()` and `trustStore.size()` (which can throw `KeyStoreException` if the keystore is uninitialized), and then calls `getCertsByIssuer` on each (which can also throw `KeyStoreException`). Finally, it calls `buildChain` (which internally may call `get` on a map with a null key, causing `NullPointerException`). None of these runtime exceptions are caught in the current code.
